item.title: CVE-2026-82578 · 8.7 HIGH 🌩️ — NextGen Healthcare Mirth Connect Improper Restriction of XML External Entity Reference
item.description: When XML batch processing is turned on and the XPath option is selected, the raw batch input goes through a default XPath/JAXP setup with no entity restrictions, so XXE injection can allow data exfiltration and denial-of-service attacks.

item.description: An integer overflow in a specified pitch and buffer-size computation leads to a heap out-of-bounds write when Orthanc DICOM Server decodes an attacker-supplied PNG.
